newsitem.title: USA: Optical Cable Q4 pretax income rises.
newsitem.headline: Optical Cable Q4 pretax income rises.

text.p: Optical Cable Corp on Thursday said fourth quarter 1996 pre-tax net income was about $4.2 million, versus $2.9 million for the same period in 1995.
Optical president and chief executive Robert Kopstein said fourth quarter earnings were between $0.06 and $0.07 per share. He said year-ago share data was not available.
Sales for the period, whch ended October 31, 1996, rose to about $13.9 million. Sales for year ending October 31, 1996, climbed to approximately $45.3 million.
Net income before tax for the year ending October 31, 1996, was approximately $12.0 million, versus $8.2 million for 1995, the company said.
